characters.MILO: Milo, a 13-year-old boy: messy curly brown hair, freckles, big expressive eyebrows, oversized forest-green hoodie with a small orange wildcat patch on the chest, blue jeans, red high-top sneakers, gray backpack
characters.JUNE: June Park, a 13-year-old Korean American girl: straight black hair in a chin-length bob with blunt bangs, mustard-yellow cardigan over a white T-shirt with a small star, dark jeans, white sneakers; wears purple sunglasses only when dancing
characters.HARPER: Harper Blake, a 14-year-old eighth-grade girl, taller than the others: long wavy strawberry-blonde hair with a white headband, blue-and-gold Westfield Wildcats varsity jacket, carries a clipboard
characters.ALVAREZ: Mr. Alvarez, a technology teacher in his forties: thick black mustache, rectangular glasses, brown sweater vest over a checked shirt, school lanyard
characters.TECHKID: a skinny tech club kid with a buzz cut, oversized headphones around his neck and a black T-shirt

world: Westfield Middle School: blue and gold school colors, a cartoon wildcat mascot, lockers, linoleum hallways, a cafeteria, and an auditorium with a red stage curtain and a big projector screen

scenes.setting: a school hallway with blue lockers and a vending machine, early morning
a sunny classroom during first period
June's cozy bedroom two weeks earlier
the school hallway by the lockers
the busy, noisy school cafeteria at lunch
backstage in the school auditorium, cables, a sound table and a red curtain
the packed school auditorium with a stage and a giant projector screen
the concrete steps outside the school gym, late afternoon light
the school auditorium during the evening talent show
the school hallway with lockers and the vending machine

panels.shot: Wide establishing shot of Westfield Middle School at 7:43 in the morning, golden early sun, kids with backpacks arriving, a blue and gold wildcat banner over the entrance

text.text: By Friday afternoon, I was going to be the most popular kid at Westfield Middle School.

panels.shot: Milo slams his palm against the glass of a hallway vending machine; a single foil-wrapped toaster pastry dangles halfway off its metal coil inside; lockers behind him
June stands behind Milo holding two small cartons of chocolate milk, one eyebrow raised, amused; Milo turns around mid-glare at the vending machine

text.text: You're negotiating with a vending machine again?

panels.shot: Close-up: June's hand reaches past Milo and presses the refund button; the pastry drops into the tray; Milo stares, jaw open
June hands Milo a carton of chocolate milk with a smug little smile; Milo holds the pastry, defeated

Split memory panel: on the left, Milo and June as eight-year-olds on a playground; on the right, the two of them now on a couch playing a kart racing video game, June winning while eating a bowl of cereal

text.text: My best friend since third grade.

panels.shot: Classroom during first period; a loudspeaker on the wall; inset circle shows Harper speaking into a microphone in the school broadcast booth
Milo sits bolt upright at his desk, eyes huge; a TV on the classroom wall shows a bright WILDCAT WEEKLY show logo with the wildcat mascot

text.text: I'd been dreaming about that job since sixth grade.

panels.shot: Flashback in a cafeteria: a younger, smaller Milo with orange juice spilled down the front of his pants, an empty juice carton in hand, kids pointing and laughing around him

text.text: People had called me Juice Boy for seven months.

panels.shot: June at the next desk turns to Milo and smiles; Milo looks hopeful
Close-up over Milo's shoulder: he holds his phone under the desk, the screen glowing with a blank messaging app; his face lit with excitement

text.text: Hey! Saw your audition. Really funny.

panels.shot: Milo stares into space, scheming; a thought cloud above his head shows June in purple sunglasses mid-dance with flailing arms

text.text: One spectacularly funny video. And it wasn't mine.

panels.shot: Two weeks earlier: June in her bedroom wearing purple sunglasses, filming herself with a phone propped on her desk; posters and fairy lights on the walls

text.text: This is take seventeen. If this is bad, I'm joining the chess club.

panels.shot: June dancing in her bedroom in purple sunglasses, arms flailing wildly like an inflatable tube man, spinning like a malfunctioning helicopter, motion lines everywhere
June topples backwards behind her bed, only her sneakers visible flying up above the mattress
The bedroom is still; a single hand rises from behind the bed giving a thumbs-up

text.text: Then one hand emerged from the floor.

panels.shot: June and Milo sit on her front porch steps; June, serious and a little scared, holds out her pinky for a pinky promise; Milo hooks his pinky in hers
Back in the school hallway: Milo stands by the lockers, his thumb hovering over his phone screen, face torn between temptation and guilt

text.text: My thumb hovered over the video.

panels.shot: Close-up of Milo grinning at his phone while one hand clutches his stomach uneasily
Busy school cafeteria at lunch: Harper high-fives Milo at his table while June, sitting across from him, nearly chokes on a french fry
Milo's smile freezes as Harper walks away waving over her shoulder
June leans across the lunch table, eyes narrowed; Milo stares down at his tray and laughs nervously
Close-up of June's face: not angry but hurt, eyes glistening
June stands holding her lunch tray, voice shaking, looking down; Milo reaches out from his seat, pleading

text.text: Because I was scared. And you always make scary things feel less scary.

panels.shot: Milo sits alone holding a single limp french fry, an empty seat across from him; the cafeteria chaos is blurred behind, a grape flying through the air

text.text: It was probably the worst french fry of my entire life.

panels.shot: Backstage in the auditorium, a wall clock reads 1:45; Harper checks notes on her clipboard as Milo approaches, nervous
Over Milo's shoulder: a laptop on the sound table shows a file folder window; his face reflected in the screen, horrified
Milo drags the file toward the trash on the laptop when a tech club kid bursts in behind him, pointing and shouting
Milo jumps; his elbow knocks over a plastic cup; water splashes across the sound table and the laptop screen goes black
Behind the red stage curtain, Mr. Alvarez throws his hands up beside a dark, dead projector
Packed auditorium at 2:25: Mr. Alvarez crouched behind the stage untangling cables, Harper pacing, the principal checking his watch, Milo slumped in the front row

text.text: Wondering whether moving to Canada was a realistic option.

panels.shot: June sits alone in the third row of the auditorium, empty seats on both sides, looking away
Harper on stage with a microphone; behind her the giant projector screen shows June's face twenty feet tall in purple sunglasses; kids in the audience point and laugh
Milo leaps up from his front-row seat, one arm thrust out, every head in the auditorium turning toward him
Milo stands alone at center stage under a spotlight speaking to three hundred students; Harper beside him, stunned, lowering her microphone; June staring from the audience

text.text: Because I sent it without permission.

panels.shot: A kid in the crowd cups his hands and shouts; students around him laugh; Milo on stage turns red
The auditorium is silent; Milo hands the microphone back to Harper and walks offstage, head down
Late afternoon: Milo sits alone, hunched, on the concrete steps outside the school gym
June sits down beside Milo on the steps and hands him a foil-wrapped toaster pastry; he looks at it, surprised

text.text: I pressed the button like a normal person.

panels.shot: June, arms crossed, firm; Milo nods, ashamed
June fights back a smile, her mouth twitching, while Milo grins at her
June holds up her phone to show Milo a video, one finger raised as she lists rules; Milo leans in eagerly
On a phone screen: June in purple sunglasses steps backwards onto a skateboard in her bedroom, arms shooting into the air
Milo and June laughing together on the gym steps, the phone between them; Milo's own phone stays in his pocket

text.text: And this time, I didn't reach for the share button.

panels.shot: Talent show three weeks later: June in purple sunglasses dances joyfully on stage under colorful lights; the audience cheers; Milo stands in the crowd cheering loudest
Backstage: June playfully punches Milo's arm; he yelps and laughs

text.text: Ow! Kidding! Eleven! Twelve! A million!

panels.shot: June, walking away, stops and looks back casually; Milo gapes in shock

text.text: Next Friday, I'm auditioning for Wildcat Weekly.

panels.shot: June smiles warmly at Milo, backstage lights behind her
School hallway: June calls back from far down the hall; Milo grabs his backpack and starts running after her
Milo walks past the vending machine, glancing at a toaster pastry stuck crookedly halfway down its coil, smiling and not stopping

text.text: Some battles just weren't worth winning.

panels.shot: Milo and June walk away together down the bright school hallway, seen from behind, backpacks on
